content.title: Conduent: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: FLORHAM PARK, N.J. (AP) — Conduent Incorporated (CNDT) on Friday reported a loss of $46 million in its third quarter. On a per-share basis, the Florham Park, New Jersey-based company said it had a loss of 30 cents. Losses, adjusted for pretax expenses and restructuring costs, came to 9 cents per share.
